subject: science
domain: Heredity: Inheritance and Variation of Traits

items.prompt:
Which is a source of inheritable genetic variation?
A) New combinations of genes
B) The weather today
C) The time of day
D) An organism's name

A mutation is
A) a change in the DNA
B) a type of cell
C) a bone
D) a kind of food
items.answer: A) a change in the DNA

steps: A mutation is a change in DNA.

items.prompt:
Inheritable means the variation can be
A) passed to offspring
B) never passed on
C) seen only once
D) destroyed

Errors during DNA replication can
A) cause genetic variation
B) never change anything
C) delete the organism
D) only help

steps: Copying errors are a source of variation.

items.prompt:
Which environmental factor can cause mutations?
A) A chemical or radiation
B) A gentle breeze
C) A sunny day
D) A friend's name

steps: Chemicals and radiation can cause mutations.

items.prompt:
Why do puppies in one litter differ genetically?
A) Each gets a different combination of the parents' genes
B) They have no genes
C) They copied each other
D) They ate different food
items.answer: A) Each gets a different combination of the parents' genes

items.prompt:
The three main sources of inheritable variation are
A) new gene combinations, DNA replication errors, and environmental mutations
B) food, water, and air
C) weather, time, and names
D) only new gene combinations
items.answer: A) new gene combinations, DNA replication errors, and environmental mutations

steps: These three sources create inheritable variation.

items.prompt:
The best-defended claim about variation in a litter is that it comes mainly from
A) new combinations of the parents' genes, since each offspring got a different mix
B) the weather
C) the puppies' names
D) nothing
items.answer: A) new combinations of the parents' genes, since each offspring got a different mix

steps: Different gene mixes explain the variation.
